state.goal: Jev-directed SUNNY construction with actual results and fail-closed source/receipt integrity.
state.facts: Actual model decisions now log full requests/distributions/model identity. Validation currently checks answer count/labels/finite normalized probabilities, but not winner-is-argmax, response type or reported truncation. APIinfo records pinned modelhash but should not silently accept another model under same service. Browser can supply boundedJSON48kbytes; upstream rejects over2048path tokens. An unchanged, complete original state must not be cropped invisibly.
state.constraints: User requires real Jev decisions and guardrail plugins. A malformed/unavailable decision must not trigger host fallback; unknown and failed states remain explicit. Test data must be labeled fixtures, not real inference.

questions.question: Which action should enforce the existing actual-decision integrity requirement?

options.strict_guards: Reject response type/label/winner inconsistencies, reported input truncation and unexpected modelhash; add regression tests then rerun a real bounded decision.
options.display_only: Keep existing checks and display additional response metadata without rejecting inconsistent or truncated decisions.
options.manual_only: Require manual inspection of every receipt without improving machine validation.
